messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.reasoning:
The user wants "list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023". They want us to fetch it from somewhere. We can use web search or we might have knowledge about Canadian holidays.

We could provide them with known public holidays in Canada (federal) for 2023:

List of federal statutory holidays in Canada:
New Year's Day – Jan 1
Family Day – third Monday in February (except BC)
Good Friday – variable
Victoria Day – last Monday in May
Canada Day – July 1
Labour Day – first Monday in September
Thanksgiving – second Monday in October
Remembrance Day – Nov 11
Christmas Day – Dec 25
Boxing Day – Dec 26

But they ask specifically for long weekends. Long weekend typically means a holiday falling on Thursday/Friday or Saturday/Sunday such that there is an extended weekend. But also includes holidays that fall on weekdays but create a long weekend due to adjacent days off.

In Canada, many provinces observe additional holidays; e.g., Family day varies per province. Also some provincial holidays may not be considered long weekends because they don't extend beyond standard weekend.

However, maybe they'd just want all dates where there's at least one holiday within a week containing a weekend. Or perhaps they'd want each holiday that falls on a weekday plus the preceding/following weekend days.

Alternatively, we could produce a table listing each holiday that creates a long weekend in Canada in 2023. For example:

January 2–5: New Year’s Holiday (if observed as a paid leave). Actually New Year's Day was Sunday Jan 1 so no extra day needed.

February 20–22: Family Day (third Monday Feb 20)

April 7–9: Good Friday & Easter Monday? Wait Good Friday is April 7, Easter Monday is April 10 (but only in certain provinces).

May 29–31: Victoria Day (Monday May 29)

July 1–3: Canada Day (Saturday Jul 1), but it's a Saturday so no extension.

September 8–10: Labour Day (Mon Sep 8)

October 13–15: Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 13)

November 10–12: Remembrance Day (Thu Nov 10?), actually Remembrance Day is Thu Nov 10? Let's check: In 2023, November 11 is Wednesday. So no long weekend unless people take time off.

December 24–27: Christmas & Boxing Day (Sunday Dec 24 - Tuesday Dec 27?). Actually December 25 is Monday, 26 Tue. That gives a long weekend from Sat Dec 23 to Mon Dec 25? Not exactly.

Better approach: Provide a simple answer: List of official federal holidays in Canada for 2023 along with their dates. Then mention which ones would result in long weekends based on typical work schedules.

Let's do research quickly via websearch tool.
